name: Kawahara_2023
partition_info: Data.S14.Model_selection_results/nt321_partitions_models.nex: 391 contiguous charsets covering all 161166 sites exactly, all lengths multiples of 3; nt6 file shows codon positions start at site 1 (1-3000\3). Locus names are Subset numbers only; a locus-name table may be in the paper supplement. aa154 file gives the 391 AA loci.
notes: Largest AHE matrix found: 2258 taxa x 161 kb. Downloaded and inspected. Springer Nature figshare record, CC BY 4.0. First 3000 sites probably COI/legacy loci (check paper). Trees in Data.S21.MLtrees.zip.

name: Burbrink_2020

name: Bybee_2021

name: Singhal_2021
alignment_file: alignments.zip (79 MB): all trimmed per-locus alignments used for tree inference
partition_info: per-locus files; concatenation and codon frames would have to be built by us
notes: Mixed capture types; 91 species plus 17 public datasets. Biggest by loci among squamate AHE sets but few taxa. Dryad downloads blocked for scripts.
